# SPECIFICATION: REWARDS EARNING RULES DISPLAY

## CURRENT STATE SUMMARY:
Today, customers earn rewards based on accelerated (merchant-specific with caps), standard, and exclusion rules configured in the system. Rewards accrue at presentment and reverse on refunds. When customers contact support asking "why did I get X% cashback instead of Y%", agents manually check merchant configurations, MID/TID mappings, and threshold caps across 800 monthly tickets, with no self-serve transparency into the earning logic applied to specific transactions.

---

## SCOPE:

### IN SCOPE:
- Transaction-level earning rule display on transaction detail screen
- Earning rate breakdown showing applied rule type
- Accelerated rewards cap consumption indicator
- Exclusion reason display for zero-earning transactions
- Earning rule explanation for reversed rewards on refunds
- Historical earning rule view for past transactions
- Support ticket deflection tracking for rule-related queries

### OUT OF SCOPE:
- Rewards burning/redemption rule display — separate feature addressing redemption flow, not earning transparency
- Rewards provisioning details to customer — internal accounting process not relevant to customer understanding of earning
- Negative balance auto-billing explanation — edge case affecting <1% users, separate communication needed
- Rewards lapse notifications — separate retention feature with different user journey
- MCC-level exclusion list display — too granular, merchant name sufficient for customer understanding
- Real-time earning rule changes during transaction — rules applied at presentment are final
- Predictive earning calculator for future transactions — requires merchant identification before transaction completion

---

## FUNCTIONAL USE CASES:

### Use Case 1: View earning rule for completed transaction (Happy Path)
**Actor:** PIXEL Credit Card customer  
**Precondition:** Customer has completed transaction that earned rewards, transaction has reached presentment stage, rewards have been credited to account  

**User Story:** As a PIXEL cardholder, I want to see exactly why I earned a specific cashback rate on my transaction so that I understand my rewards without calling support.

**Steps:**
1. Customer opens PIXEL app and navigates to transaction history
2. Customer taps on specific transaction to view details
3. System displays transaction detail screen with rewards earning section
4. System shows earning rule applied: "Accelerated Rewards: 5% cashback on Swiggy (up to ₹500/month)" or "Standard Rewards: 1% cashback"
5. If accelerated with cap, system displays progress: "₹320 of ₹500 monthly cap used"
6. Customer views breakdown and understands earning without external help

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given customer views transaction with accelerated rewards, when transaction detail loads, then earning section displays rule name, rate, merchant match, and cap consumption in single view
- Given customer views transaction with standard rewards, when transaction detail loads, then earning section displays "Standard Rewards: 1% cashback" with no additional complexity
- Given customer views transaction within 2 seconds of detail screen tap, when rewards data is available, then earning rule section renders without separate loading state
- Given customer has multiple transactions on same merchant in same month, when viewing later transactions, then cap consumption reflects cumulative usage across all transactions
- Given transaction earned rewards 30 days ago, when customer views historical transaction, then earning rule displayed matches rule active at transaction presentment date

**Failure State AC:**
- Given rewards calculation is still processing, when customer views transaction detail, then earning section shows "Rewards processing - check back in 24 hours" with estimated completion time
- Given system cannot retrieve earning rule metadata, when transaction detail loads, then earning section shows reward points earned with "Rule details unavailable" and support contact option

**Priority:** P0

---

### Use Case 2: View exclusion reason for zero-earning transaction (Edge Case)
**Actor:** PIXEL Credit Card customer  
**Precondition:** Customer completed transaction on excluded merchant category (fuel/wallet load/EMI), transaction posted but earned zero rewards  

**User Story:** As a PIXEL cardholder, I want to understand why I didn't earn rewards on a transaction so that I know which purchases don't qualify.

**Steps:**
1. Customer notices transaction in history with ₹0 rewards earned
2. Customer taps transaction to view details expecting to see earning
3. System displays transaction detail with rewards earning section
4. System shows exclusion reason: "No rewards earned: Fuel purchases excluded from rewards program" or "No rewards earned: Wallet load transactions excluded"
5. System provides link to full rewards terms showing all exclusion categories
6. Customer understands exclusion policy without contacting support

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given transaction is on excluded MCC, when customer views transaction detail, then earning section displays specific exclusion reason matching merchant category
- Given transaction is EMI conversion, when customer views transaction detail, then earning section displays "EMI transactions do not earn rewards per program terms"
- Given transaction is wallet load to Payzapp/other wallets, when customer views transaction detail, then earning section displays "Wallet load transactions excluded from rewards"
- Given customer taps "View full terms" link, when link is activated, then app navigates to rewards program terms with exclusions section highlighted
- Given multiple exclusion reasons could apply, when transaction detail loads, then system displays primary exclusion reason based on MCC-level rule

**Failure State AC:**
- Given transaction earned zero rewards due to system error not exclusion, when customer views detail, then earning section shows "Rewards calculation pending - contact support if not updated in 48 hours" with ticket creation option

**Priority:** P0

---

### Use Case 3: View reversed rewards explanation on refunded transaction (Failure)
**Actor:** PIXEL Credit Card customer  
**Precondition:** Customer received refund for previously rewarded transaction, rewards have been reversed from account, customer sees negative adjustment in rewards balance  

**User Story:** As a PIXEL cardholder, I want to see why rewards were deducted from my account so that I understand the reversal is linked to my refund.

**Steps:**
1. Customer notices rewards balance decreased and checks transaction history
2. Customer finds original purchase transaction and taps to view details
3. System displays transaction detail showing refund status
4. System shows earning section with reversal explanation: "Original rewards: +50 points | Refund processed: -50 points | Net rewards: 0"
5. System links to refund transaction showing reversal date
6. Customer understands reversal is proportional to refund amount

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given transaction has been fully refunded, when customer views original transaction detail, then earning section displays original earning, reversal amount, and net zero with refund date
- Given transaction has been partially refunded, when customer views original transaction detail, then earning section displays original earning, partial reversal amount, and remaining net rewards
- Given reversal caused negative rewards balance, when customer views transaction detail, then earning section includes warning: "Negative balance will be adjusted from future earnings or billed after 2 statement cycles"
- Given refund processed in different month than original transaction, when customer views detail, then earning section shows both original earning date and reversal date clearly
- Given customer taps refund transaction link, when link is activated, then app navigates to refund transaction detail showing corresponding positive adjustment

**Failure State AC:**
- Given rewards reversal is processing but not yet reflected, when customer views transaction detail within 24 hours of refund, then earning section shows "Rewards reversal processing - balance will update within 24 hours"
- Given system cannot match reversal to original transaction, when customer views detail, then earning section shows "Rewards adjustment applied - contact support for details" with ticket creation option

**Priority:** P1

---

## NON-FUNCTIONAL USE CASES:

### Performance:
- **Transaction detail load time with earning rules**: Earning rule section must render within 2 seconds of transaction detail screen load on 4G connection
  - **Acceptance:** 95th percentile load time <2s measured via Firebase Performance Monitoring across 10,000 transaction detail views

- **Earning rule data cache duration**: Earning rule metadata for transactions >7 days old must be cached locally to reduce API calls
  - **Acceptance:** Cache hit rate >80% for historical transaction views measured via instrumentation, API calls reduced by 60% for repeat views

### Security:
- **Earning rule configuration exposure**: Detailed earning rule logic (MID/TID mappings, exact thresholds, merchant contracts) must not be exposed in client-side code or API responses
  - **Acceptance:** Security audit confirms no sensitive rule configuration in mobile app bundle or API response payloads, only customer-facing descriptions transmitted

### Accessibility:
- **Screen reader support for earning rules**: Earning rule section must be fully navigable and readable via TalkBack/VoiceOver
  - **Acceptance:** Accessibility audit confirms all earning rule text, cap progress indicators, and links have proper labels and reading order

### Reliability:
- **Graceful degradation for missing rule data**: App must display transaction details even if earning rule metadata is unavailable
  - **Acceptance:** Transaction detail screen loads successfully showing basic transaction info + reward points earned with "Rule details unavailable" message when rule metadata API fails, measured via error rate monitoring <0.1% crash rate on detail screen

---

## METRICS IMPACT:

### Support Ticket Volume - Rewards Earning Queries:
- **Current baseline:** 800 tickets/month (from problem statement)
- **Expected impact:** 60% reduction to 320 tickets/month within 3 months of launch
- **Owner:** Customer Support Operations team

### Transaction Detail Screen Engagement:
- **Current baseline:** Unknown — check with analytics team for current transaction detail view rate
- **Expected impact:** 25% increase in transaction detail views as customers proactively check earning rules
- **Owner:** Product Analytics team

### Rewards Program NPS:
- **Current baseline:** Unknown — check with CX team for current rewards-related NPS score
- **Expected impact:** 15-point improvement in rewards-related NPS driven by transparency and reduced confusion
- **Owner:** Customer Experience team

---

## NEW METRICS TO TRACK:

### Earning Rule Section View Rate:
- **Definition:** Percentage of transaction detail views where earning rule section is visible in viewport (scrolled into view)
- **Target:** >70% of transaction detail views scroll to earning rule section within 30 days of launch
- **Owner:** Product Analytics team

### Exclusion Reason View Rate:
- **Definition:** Number of zero-earning transaction details viewed / total zero-earning transactions
- **Target:** >40% of customers with excluded transactions view transaction detail to understand exclusion
- **Owner:** Product Analytics team

### Support Ticket Deflection Attribution:
- **Definition:** Support tickets created within 5 minutes of viewing earning rule section (indicates feature did not answer question)
- **Target:** <5% of earning rule section views result in immediate support ticket creation
- **Owner:** Customer Support Operations team

### Earning Rule "View Terms" Link CTR:
- **Definition:** Clicks on "View full terms" link / earning rule section views
- **Target:** 8-12% CTR indicating healthy interest in detailed terms without overwhelming majority needing it
- **Owner:** Product Analytics team

---

## REPORTS & EXTRACTS IMPACT:

### New reports needed:
- Daily Earning Rule Display Performance Report: Transaction detail views, earning rule section views, load times, error rates by rule type
- Weekly Support Deflection Report: Ticket volume trends for rewards earning queries, correlation with feature adoption
- Monthly Earning Rule Accuracy Audit: Sample transactions with earning rules displayed vs. actual rules applied in core banking system

### Existing reports affected:
- Customer Support Ticket Category Report: Add new deflection tracking flag for tickets created after viewing earning rule section
- Transaction Detail Analytics Report: Add earning rule section engagement metrics to existing transaction detail funnel
- Rewards Reconciliation Report: No changes required, earning display does not affect accrual/provisioning calculations

### Reconciliation requirements:
- Daily reconciliation: Earning rules displayed in app must match earning rules applied in Zeta rewards engine for same transaction ID
- Monthly audit: Sample 1000 random transactions, verify displayed rule matches transaction metadata in core system, target 99.9% accuracy

### Data extract requirements:
- Customer Support team: Daily extract of transactions with earning rule views + subsequent ticket creation for deflection analysis
- Business Intelligence team: Weekly extract of earning rule type distribution (accelerated/standard/excluded) across transaction volume
- Compliance team: Quarterly extract of exclusion reason display frequency to verify customer communication alignment with terms

---

## INSTRUMENTATION REQUIREMENTS:

### Event 1: zcrw_earning_rule_viewed
- **Trigger:** Earning rule section becomes visible in viewport on transaction detail screen (50% of section visible for >1 second)
- **Properties:**
  - `transaction_id` (string): Unique transaction identifier
  - `rule_type` (string): "accelerated" | "standard" | "excluded" | "reversed"
  - `reward_points_earned` (integer): Points earned/reversed on transaction
  - `cap_shown` (boolean): Whether cap consumption indicator was displayed
  - `time_since_transaction` (integer): Days between transaction date and view date
- **Purpose:** Measure feature adoption and identify which rule types drive most customer interest

### Event 2: zcrw_earning_rule_interaction
- **Trigger:** User taps interactive element within earning rule section
- **Properties:**
  - `transaction_id` (string): Unique transaction identifier
  - `interaction_type` (string): "view_terms_link" | "cap_details_expand" | "refund_link"
  - `rule_type` (string): "accelerated" | "standard" | "excluded" | "reversed"
- **Purpose:** Understand which earning rule details require deeper explanation and optimize content

### Event 3: zcrw_earning_rule_load_failure
- **Trigger:** Earning rule metadata API call fails or times out when loading transaction detail
- **Properties:**
  - `transaction_id` (string): Unique transaction identifier
  - `error_code` (string): API error code or timeout indicator
  - `fallback_shown` (boolean): Whether fallback "details unavailable" message was displayed
  - `retry_attempted` (boolean): Whether automatic retry was triggered
- **Purpose:** Monitor reliability and identify systemic issues with earning rule data retrieval

### Event 4: zcrw_support_ticket_created_post_view
- **Trigger:** User creates support ticket within 5 minutes of viewing earning rule section
- **Properties:**
  - `transaction_id` (string): Transaction ID that was viewed before ticket creation
  - `rule_type` (string): Rule type that was displayed
  - `ticket_category` (string): Support ticket category selected by user
  - `seconds_since_view` (integer): Time between earning rule view and ticket creation
- **Purpose:** Measure feature effectiveness at deflecting support queries and identify gaps in explanation

### Event 5: zcrw_exclusion_reason_viewed
- **Trigger:** User views transaction detail for zero-earning transaction where exclusion reason is displayed
- **Properties:**
  - `transaction_id` (string): Unique transaction identifier
  - `exclusion_category` (string): "fuel" | "wallet_load" | "emi" | "other"
  - `merchant_name` (string): Merchant name on excluded transaction
  - `terms_link_shown` (boolean): Whether "View full terms" link was displayed
- **Purpose:** Track exclusion communication effectiveness and identify most common exclusion scenarios requiring education

---

## EXTERNAL RESEARCH SUMMARY:

- ICICI and Axis Bank display earning rates on transaction SMS but not in-app transaction details with rule explanations
- CSB Edge card MITC shows fee transparency trend but no evidence of transaction-level earning rule display in competitor apps
- Customer complaints on Economic Times forums focus on unexpected earning rates suggesting industry-wide transparency gap
